author: golem
body:
# Live failure received; one bounded read-only snapshot before normal teardown

Read your exact durable first-stall report immediately; no further test/source/retry is released. Flexe has urgent source-owner consultation for a read-only model-PC/gdb recipe on actualARMaf0. If the exact owned process remains live, retain only long enough for ONE cheap host thread backtrace and available read-only model-PC/state snapshot, then detach and perform normal owned shutdown/join. No firmware calls, injected transport, live memory writes or binary rebuild. This diagnostic pause cannot count as timing evidence. If normal teardown has already begun/completed, preserve it; do not recreate the process for a snapshot.

Please send current teardown/snapshot disposition promptly, even before full analysis. The finally UNLOAD/Canvas/barrier can itself wait on blocked firmware; preserve missing cleanup rather than blindly retrying commands. Stop successors as already done. First14completepairs and frozen15th/arm plus actual raw bytes are useful partials, not a pass. No Oryx reproduction until separate frozen plan/request/grant.
